description: This file implements a logging integration with Datadog's LLM Observability Service for the litellm project. It defines a class DataDogLLMObsLogger that manages batching and sending observability payloads to Datadog, including handling success and failure events, extracting and processing metadata, and ensuring proper serialization of spans and metrics. The code also includes methods for managing tool call metadata, constructing payloads, and interfacing with external services like httpx.

classes.name: DataDogLLMObsLogger
classes.description: A logger class for integrating with Datadog's LLM Observability Service, handling batching, metadata extraction, and payload transmission.
